text: This report recommends approving a contract with Johnson Controls Canada LP ("Johnson") for the upgrade of existing HVAC control system (Building Automation System) and integration of Variable Frequency Drives (VFD) to optimize energy savings at the Enercare Centre. The request for Quotation Call was issued on March 15, 2024 through Exhibition Place Purchasing and Materials Stores via the Bonfire Online Procurement System, and the recommendation is to award the contract to the lowest compliant bidder meeting requirements and specifications within the available budget.

The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Approved the award of Contract No. 24-075-47521 (EPRFQ-2024-20138151) to Johnson Controls Canada LP for the Supply and Install of BAS Johnson Controls Metasys BACnet System N2 Upgrade and VFD Integration at Enercare Centre in the amount of $376,360.00 which includes a cash allowance of $15,000.00 but excludes HST; this being the lowest acceptable quotation submission received following the public request for quotation for the project.
